provenance: written by bin/ablate_threshold.py by re-counting every patch the index names, so every number in this document is a function of those patches, of the per-slide gray threshold recorded in `per_slide_gray_threshold`, and of the resolved parameters under `config` — which is what this run used and not the shipped file. Each per-slide gray threshold is the configured percentile of that slide's own recorded tissue_gray values, so it is a function of how that slide is stained: the per-specimen ratios and their spread beside them are therefore not separable from per-slide staining intensity, and a difference between two specimens here cannot be read as a difference between two patients without a measurement this project has not made. The counts are morphological blob counts and not a pathologist's grade, so the ceiling of anything computed from this file is agreement with a hand-tuned counter

threshold_range_coverage.criterion: brackets_distribution is true iff swept_min <= count_min and swept_max >= count_max

counting_rule_comparison.source: 60 accepted patches of data/2.svs at 0.5001 um/px, measured in Task 6

rule_in_use.rule: 95th percentile of the slide's tissue_gray column

superseded_rule.rule: 95th percentile of the patch's own grayscale
